info.title: Wichtler API
info.description:
Headless API der Wichtel-App.

Die Anmeldung läuft über HttpOnly-Cookies: `BEARER` (JWT, 15 Minuten) und
`refresh_token` (14 Tage, einmal verwendbar). Beide setzt der Server.

post.summary: Sign in with username and password

200.description: Signed in. Sets the BEARER and refresh_token cookies.

401.description: Wrong credentials, or too many failed attempts

post.summary: Renew the session with the refresh_token cookie

200.description: Session renewed. Sets new BEARER and refresh_token cookies.

401.description: Refresh token missing, expired or already used

post.summary: Sign out and clear the session cookies

delete.summary: Acknowledge the hint that exclusions were removed

403.description: Not a member of this group

409.description: The current user does not take part, or the group has been drawn

delete.description: Not possible for the group admin and not after the draw.

409.description: The group has been drawn, or the current user is its group admin or not a member

get.summary: Find users by name or username

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Words that have to occur in first name, last name or username. Empty lists everyone.

patch.summary: Change a user's name and username
patch.description: Changing the username signs the user out everywhere; they sign in again with the new one.

409.description: The Wichtler admin edits the own account in the profile

post.summary: Give a user a temporary password
post.description: The server generates the password and returns it once. The user is signed out everywhere and has to choose a new password after signing in with it.

409.description: The Wichtler admin changes the own password in the profile

post.summary: Create an account and sign in
post.description: Sets the BEARER and refresh_token cookies like a login.

201.description: Account created, user is signed in

429.description: Too many registrations from this address

get.summary: What is still missing before the group can be drawn

post.description: Picks one assignment uniformly at random from all valid ones. Afterwards members, exclusions and the rules of the group are locked, and unanswered invitations lapse. The response never contains the result.

409.description: Already drawn, not ready, or no assignment could be found

delete.description: Removes all assignments and unlocks the group again. Participants who already looked at their result know the old one.

409.description: The group has not been drawn

get.summary: Who the current user gives a present to, with that person's wishes
get.description: The app requests this only when the user chooses to reveal it.

409.description: Not drawn yet, or the current user did not take part in the draw

get.summary: Who a given participant gives a present to
get.description: Wichtler admin only. One participant per request, so nothing is transferred before it is revealed.

409.description: The group has not been drawn

get.summary: The current user's own exclusions and how many are allowed

403.description: Not a member of this group

409.description: The current user does not take part, or the group has been drawn

put.summary: Exclude a participant from one's own draw
put.description: Refused when the current user has reached the limit, or the participant is already excluded by as many others as the limit allows.

422.description: One of the two limits would be exceeded

403.description: Not a member of this group

409.description: The current user does not take part, or the group has been drawn

403.description: Not a member of this group

409.description: The current user does not take part, or the group has been drawn

get.summary: Groups of the current user, or all groups for the Wichtler admin

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: "all" is reserved for the Wichtler admin.

403.description: scope=all without being the Wichtler admin

post.summary: Create a group. The creator becomes its group admin and first participant.

403.description: Not a member of this group

delete.description: Refused once the group has been drawn; the draw has to be deleted first. This also holds for the Wichtler admin.

409.description: The group has been drawn

patch.description: Expects the complete group. After the draw only title, description and event date may change.

409.description: The draw has locked one of the changed fields

get.summary: Invitations by username the current user has not answered yet

post.summary: Join the group of an invitation by username

404.description: No such pending invitation for the current user
No such pending invitation for the current user

get.summary: What a share link invites to
get.description: Requires a session, so anonymous visitors learn nothing about the group.

post.summary: Join a group through its share link
post.description: Succeeds without effect for users who are in the group already.

patch.description: Renews the session cookies, because the tokens carry the username.

put.description: Signs out every other device and renews the session cookies of this one.

get.description: Pending invitations are only listed for the group admin.

post.description: The user has to confirm the invitation before taking part.

409.description: The group has been drawn

422.description: Unknown username, or already in the group

delete.summary: Remove a participant or withdraw an invitation

409.description: The group has been drawn, or the member is the group admin

patch.summary: Mark a participant as inactive or active
patch.description: Inactive participants stay listed but are not drawn.

409.description: The group has been drawn, the member is the group admin, or has not joined yet

get.summary: The current share link of a group

409.description: The group has been drawn

post.description: The previous link stops working immediately.

409.description: The group has been drawn

get.summary: The current user's own wishes in this group

409.description: The current user has not joined this group

403.description: Not a member of this group

409.description: Not a member, or the wish list is full

403.description: Not a member of this group

delete.summary: Delete one of the own wishes
delete.description: After the draw a wish can only be deleted while the minimum number of wishes stays met.

409.description: Not a member, or the draw requires this many wishes

403.description: Not a member of this group

patch.summary: Edit one of the own wishes
patch.description: Expects the complete wish. Allowed after the draw as well.

409.description: The current user has not joined this group

403.description: Not a member of this group

budgetMin.description: Whole units of the currency. Omit both budget fields for "no budget".

excluded.description: The current user has excluded this participant.

limit.description: How many participants one may exclude: floor(participants / 2) - 1.

remaining.description: How many more the current user may exclude.

editable.description: False once the group has been drawn.

prunedNotice.description: Exclusions of the current user were removed because the group shrank.

mustChangePassword.description: A temporary password has been set and not been replaced yet.

temporaryPassword.description: Shown exactly once. It is not stored in readable form and cannot be retrieved again.

mustChangePassword.description: True after an admin reset: the user must set a new password.

wishCount.description: How many wishes the participant has entered so far. Never the wishes themselves.

missingWishes.description: Active participants who still have too few wishes.

pendingInvitations.description: Invitations by username that have not been answered. They lapse with the draw.

hasExclusions.description: Somebody has set an exclusion. Not who, and not how many.

drawable.description: Computed: enough participants, everyone has enough wishes, not drawn yet.

isOwner.description: The current user is the group admin.

isMember.description: The current user has joined the group. False when the Wichtler admin looks at a foreign group.

isParticipant.description: The current user takes part in the draw (status "active").

canManage.description: The current user may edit and delete the group.

database.description: Whether the database answered a trivial query.

memberId.description: Id of the pending invitation by username, if there is one.

alreadyJoined.description: The current user is in the group already.

id.description: Id of the membership, not of the user.

isOwner.description: This member is the group admin.

token.description: Secret of the share link. The link is "/einladung/{token}" on the app's own address.
